name: walkthroughs
purpose: An optional SDK for showing an agent, stack or distro working as a simulated Windows 11 click-through. A walkthrough is one JSON file pinned to the file it shows; one shared player draws it as text only. People follow the click-through instead of reading.

walkthrough.py.purpose: The SDK: new, check, repin. Optional for any publisher.

player.html.purpose: The one player for every walkthrough; shows walkthrough words as text only.

README.md.purpose: What a walkthrough is and how to make one.

walkthroughs/brainstem-skill.json.purpose: First walkthrough: give your AI a Brainstem.

install.notes: Open player.html?w=<name>. To make one: python3 walkthrough.py new <name> <file it shows>.
